scope: Read-only design review. No implementation, installation, live test, logging change or active-build change.
central_rule: Request failure is not proof of unchanged text. Track write certainty separately from request/callback status.
acceptance_contract: Inside the actual granted write session, revalidate operation generation, document/field, paragraph/ranges, reviewed source, editable/protected state and composition state. Earlier validation alone is insufficient.
An accepted asynchronous request without its callback remains pending. Same-context readback must confirm the intended post-image before reporting verified application.
If text changed but a later caret, notification or bookkeeping step fails, report applied with an error. Report verified applied, partial and uncertain outcomes separately.
Stop on the first error or uncertain write. Do not blindly retry, guess offsets, issue global Undo, or run compensating writes after focus or ownership is lost.
Cancellation invalidates future callbacks and undo rearming; it does not imply rollback of a committed write. Never redirect a late callback to the newly focused field.
One-tap Apply All approves the immutable reviewed N-change plan, not transactional atomicity. Validate overlaps, boundaries and source freshness; report k of N verified applied when interrupted.

Per-change and batch undo are guarded inverse writes only for still-owned verified post-images in the same document/range/revision. Skip already restored items, preserve anchors across unequal replacement lengths, and decline on divergence.
Interrupted application or undo stops safely and reports verified-applied, verified-restored and unresolved counts separately. A failed or uncertain restoration must not be reported as rolled back.

Include an explicitly bounded result/undo phase in the operation. Retain only necessary transient in-memory pre/post-images and range identities, then purge on dismissal, invalidating edits, focus/document change or supersession. No retained typing buffer, persistent text logs, or text hashes in telemetry.

Qualify host-native undo/recovery per supported host before claiming it survives the transient operation. Unsupported hosts must not promise unconditional recovery; a TSF document lock is not a demonstrated transaction/rollback guarantee.
proposed_fixtures: Pre-write refusal, protected/read-only fields, stale source and active composition.
Withheld, cancelled, late and duplicate asynchronous callbacks.
Failure before, during and after a verified write, including unavailable readback.
Failure at each batch edit; unequal-length replacements; focus/newer typing during application.
Per-item undo followed by batch undo, interrupted undo, external edits before undo and failed restoration.
Rich text, multi-region ranges, embedded objects and paragraph boundaries.
Separate, deduplicated non-text accounting for acceptance, verified application, error, verified restoration and unresolved outcomes.
suggested_criterion: Per-change and batch undo restore only verified, still-owned changes without overwriting intervening edits. Interrupted application or undo must stop safely and report verified, restored and unresolved outcomes separately. Supported hosts must demonstrate a recovery path for post-write interruption; unconditional rollback or atomicity is never inferred from an HRESULT.
